description: This file contains internal hash function implementations based on MurmurHash3, including inline functions for bit rotations, block retrieval, and final mixing, used within jemalloc's internal hashing mechanisms.

methods.name: hash_rotl_32
methods.description: Performs a 32-bit rotate left operation on the input integer.

methods.name: hash_rotl_64
methods.description: Performs a 64-bit rotate left operation on the input integer.

methods.name: hash_get_block_32
methods.description: Retrieves a 32-bit block from a given pointer and index.

methods.name: hash_get_block_64
methods.description: Retrieves a 64-bit block from a given pointer and index.

methods.name: hash_fmix_32
methods.description: Final mixing function for 32-bit hash values.

methods.name: hash_fmix_64
methods.description: Final mixing function for 64-bit hash values.

methods.name: hash_x86_128
methods.description: Implements MurmurHash3 for 128-bit hash on x86 architecture.

methods.name: hash_x64_128
methods.description: Implements MurmurHash3 for 128-bit hash on x64 architecture.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: API function that selects the appropriate hash implementation based on architecture.
